name: find_object
description: Find, track, and approach a named object as one complete goal. After approaching, the robot performs a maximum-effort search and must reacquire stable tracking; otherwise it resumes finding. Call once and use stop_goal to cancel.

target.description: The specific object to find and approach.

name: watch_target
description: Start continuous camera tracking. If succeeded, tracking remains active until replaced by another camera action or stopped with stop_tracking.

target.description: The specific person, body part, or object concerned by the request.

name: see_action
description: Look at the current scene and answer a visual question. Optionally move the camera to a semantic region first; the observation is always captured after the camera settles, so never call a separate camera-move tool.

query.description: What to inspect or determine from the new camera image.

region.description: Optional camera direction to move to before observing; null keeps the current view.

name: navigate_action
description: Goal-mode navigation. The robot may repeatedly inspect a local map crop and camera view, choose safe Nav2 waypoints, and roam until the complete movement goal is visibly confirmed, blocked, stopped, or a safety limit is reached. Call once for the whole navigation goal.

query.description: The complete destination or roaming goal, including any visual arrival condition.

completion_mode.description: Use single_move when one bounded displacement or turn directly completes the request, such as nudge forward, move slightly, back up a little, or turn left. Use verify_goal for destinations, roaming, and goals requiring fresh visual confirmation after waypoints.

name: follow_action
description: Find a person, initialize camera/ToF-assisted lidar tracking, then continuously follow the lidar-estimated person pose with Nav2. This remains active until stopped.

target.description: The person to follow. Use person for an unspecified person.
